newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy September fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy September fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy two low-sulphur fuel oil cargoes for delivery in September, a company source said on Thursday.
The tender seeks to buy one 0.5-percent and one 1.0 percent low-pour cargoes for delivery in the second half of September, the source said.
The tender closes on August 6 and is valid for two days.

The source said the recent weak Taiwan dollar, which plunged on Thursday to the lowest level since 1988, could affect the state company's long-term crude buying plan but was so far unlikely to change its spot purchase for fuel oil.
In its last purchase, Taiwan bought two fuel oil cargoes at $129 and $120 per tonne for September delivery.
The first 38,000-tonne low-pour cargo was bought at around $129 per tonne for September 1-10 delivery and the second high-pour cargo was at $120 for September 21-30.
